plugin.note: Rune dragon strategy: draconic dragonbane target with Earth weakness. Tumeken's shadow is excellent; handle lightning bolts with movement or insulated boots.

requirements: Insulated boots optional for lightning damage reduction
mechanics: Rune dragons use melee, ranged, magic, and dragonfire.
Lightning bolts pursue the player and deal repeated damage.
Onyx-bolt style ranged special heals the dragon for damage dealt and ignores Protect from Missiles.
They have 50% earth spell vulnerability and the draconic attribute.

methods.label: Dragonfire protection
methods.summary: Use full dragonfire protection in Lithkren Vault.
requiredOrKeyItems: Super antifire or shield plus antifire
steps: Access Lithkren Vault after Dragon Slayer II.
Use dragonbane melee or Magic for reliable kills.

methods.label: Special attacks
methods.summary: Move from lightning bolts and account for the Onyx-bolt style healing attack.
steps: Run four to five squares away when lightning bolts are launched.
Wear insulated boots to reduce lightning damage from 4-7 per tick to 1-2 per tick.
Expect the Onyx-bolt style ranged special to heal the dragon for damage dealt.
Continue using dragonbane or Earth-weakness damage.

styleOptions.label: Melee dragonbane
styleOptions.summary: Dragon hunter lance or fang setup.

styleOptions.label: Earth Magic
styleOptions.summary: Tumeken's shadow, dragon hunter wand, or Earth spell setup.

styleOptions.label: Ranged dragonbane
styleOptions.summary: Dragon hunter crossbow or ranged alternative.

body:
# Rune dragon

Draconic dragonbane target with Earth weakness. Tumeken's shadow is excellent; handle lightning bolts with movement or insulated boots.
